governing_goal: Adopt the user-provided deep-task protocol as an actual UAOS execution contract for explicit depth requests and materially deep tasks, without creating a second cognition state machine. A deep task must be grounded in governing outcome, professional-practice gaps, primary/raw evidence, concrete methods/tools, unknown-signal search, competing alternatives and falsification, feasibility-bounded stretch targets, independent judge evidence, holdout/replay/production validation and explicit acceptance criteria before controlled finalization may claim completion.
starting_evidence: DELIBERATION_POLICY 2.0 already covers governing outcome, competing hypotheses, falsification, external research, independent verification and V&V, but it has no one deep-task admission that requires the full evidence bundle for an explicit depth request.
EVOLUTION_POLICY 2.0 carries raw evidence/professional methods/novelty/external judge only for governed evolution, not for arbitrary deep research, design or decision tasks.

CognitionCase currently validates typed evidence, causal alternatives, intervention tradeoffs and V&V for problem cases, but a non-problem deep task can still finalize without proving the user-provided depth dimensions.
The previous assistant response described the protocol as accepted for material tasks without first persisting or enforcing that adoption.
external_method_basis: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook: requirements should be traceable to defined verification/validation methods and plans.
NIST AI RMF/TEVV: testing should document test sets, metrics and tools, involve independent assessors, resemble deployment conditions and continue in production.
SEI ATAM: architecture should be evaluated against business drivers, scenarios, risks, sensitivity points and tradeoffs rather than familiarity or structural description alone.

architecture_candidates.reason: Would preserve a gap between verbal deep-task intent and executable completion admission.
Would compete with the canonical cognition kernel and violate the anti-bloat/one-cognition-owner rule.
Deep tasks include research/design/decision work that may not trigger governed evolution.
Keeps the existing cognition kernel as owner, adds a reusable deep-task evidence case/admission, and lets controlled finalization fail closed when deep-task execution is explicitly required.

next_action: Implement a reusable DeepTaskCase admission, wire it into controlled finalization, update DELIBERATION_POLICY/common capability authority and add regressions that block completion when any required deep-task evidence dimension is missing.
